title: Physiotherapy
hero.text: For patients experiencing pain, reduced movement, weakness or balance difficulties, to improve mobility, strength, balance and coordination.

overview: If a patient’s movement has been affected by trauma, injury, surgery or a medical condition, physiotherapy can help restore coordination, strength, balance, endurance and flexibility, while managing chronic pain and addressing postural problems.

blocks.text: Physiotherapy helps patients recover movement and function after injury, surgery or illness.

Our physiotherapists assess each patient’s individual needs and goals, then use evidence-based techniques to help them achieve their best possible level of physical function. Each treatment plan is tailored to the patient, with their family involved throughout their care.

items: Musculoskeletal injuries affecting muscles, bones, joints and ligaments
Recovery after stroke and other neurological conditions
Reduced mobility, weakness or loss of coordination after illness or injury

blocks.text: Our physiotherapists may use a combination of techniques, depending on the patient’s condition and treatment goals:

items: Athetoid CP: Muscle toning and control training
Ataxic CP: Balance and resistance training
Faster recovery after surgery or injury
